notes: Filter applied: Recyclers only (Refurbishers and Dismantlers excluded).
- Authorised E-Waste Recyclers/Refurbishers - March 2024 (Maharashtra Pollution Control Board, MPCB)
- List of Recycler/Refurbisher for Management of E-Waste in the State of Punjab (Punjab Pollution Control Board)
Coverage: 41 Maharashtra entries classified as 'Recycler' + 8 Punjab entries = 49 total rows.

Maharashtra: entries were kept only if MPCB's own Type column labeled them 'Recycler' (some companies hold multiple authorizations, e.g. Recycler + Refurbisher; these are kept since they do include a Recycler authorization, and both capacities are shown). Entries classified purely as Refurbisher or Dismantler were removed. 3 Maharashtra entries had no recoverable type/capacity data in the source PDF (WE-The Recycling Company, Kuldeep Green Recyclers Private Limited, Vozon Comsof Pvt Ltd) and were excluded since their classification could not be confirmed.

Punjab: the source list does not classify individual companies as Recycler vs. Refurbisher at all - it is titled 'List of Recycler/Refurbisher...' as a single combined list with no per-row distinction. All 8 Punjab entries are therefore kept here, since there's no way to separate them from the source data. If you only want confirmed recyclers, you may want to verify these directly with the Punjab Pollution Control Board.

- 'What They Accept / Type': reflects MPCB's Recycler/Refurbisher/Dismantler classification and authorised annual capacity (MT/A) for e-waste in general - the source does not itemise specific material categories (batteries, IT equipment, etc).
- 'License / Authorization No.': Consent-to-Operate and/or Authorization numbers; multiple entries separated by semicolons.
- Punjab rows have no phone/email/license/capacity because the source PDF did not include this data.

Data quality caveat: the Maharashtra source PDF had some misaligned rows from PDF text extraction (e.g. around Sr. No. 2, 42-44, 89-90), which were manually reconciled using context. Always verify critical details against the original PDFs or MPCB/PPCB websites before relying on this for compliance purposes.
